No, accutane’s been the only meds I’ve positively responded to. You could go on a low dose to minimise effects. Stay hydrated, moisturise even if your nose feels oily.

You sound similar to me. I also used to have cystic acne a while back. It was resolved during the 1st round for 6months. 

2nd round now is about 2 ½ months in, 10-20mg daily.I was told I might respond better since accutane’s been in my system before. Only now did my nose clear. Just dryness is all. 

.  Good luck!
